excerpt.zh:
对[from.solar_system.GetName]的进一步分析发现该恒星系中所有的行星公转轨道都呈现出了相似的异常。

在利用异常的运动对重力源进行三角定位后，我们发现了个中缘由：一颗此前没有发现的行星，现在我们将其命名为[invisible_planet.GetName]。

这颗星球表面拥有独特的炭黑颗粒，完全不反射可见光和无线电波，使其对长程扫描完全隐身。

这些天然产生的聚合物具有绝佳的吸收性能。我们将对其进行采收并研究其作为隐身材料的潜在价值。

texts.en:
Further analysis of [from.solar_system.GetName] found that all planetary orbits in this system exhibit similar irregularities.

After triangulating the gravitational forces implied by these unusual movements, we discovered their cause: a previously unseen planet now known as [invisible_planet.GetName].

This world possesses a unique surface of carbon black particles which reflect no light or radio waves, making it virtually invisible to long-range scanners.

These naturally occurring polymers have remarkably absorbent properties. They will be harvested and studied for their potential uses as a stealth material.
